borrow_or_financing: none (long-only spot ETFs and SHY; any fund-level leverage, e.g. UPAR/NTSX, is inside the fund NAV, not modeled separately)
cost_model: sum(abs(delta_weight)) * slippage_bps, charged on the execution session (next session open after the close signal)
k2_control_cost_model: the vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control pays no rebalancing cost (conservative in the control's favor, matching H-20260927-01's Ci convention)
